topology_note: MLS1 is a 3560 L3 switch. SVI VLAN 10 = 10.10.10.1/24, SVI VLAN 20 = 10.10.20.1/24. Trunk Gi0/1 connects to an access switch SW2.
expected_fault: The 'ip routing' command has not been enabled on the L3 switch (show run confirms 'no ip routing'). Without it, the switch cannot route between VLANs even though both SVIs are up. The pruned VLAN 30 on the trunk is a red herring — it is irrelevant to the inter-VLAN routing failure.
source_evidence:
MLS1# show ip interface brief

Vlan10                     10.10.10.1      YES manual up                    up
Vlan20                     10.10.20.1      YES manual up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/1         unassigned      YES unset  up                    up

MLS1# show ip route
